question: How must one who is firmly resolved treat this extracted teaching?
premises: This extraction is a special teaching.
The concealment is always required for the firmly resolved.
inference: One who is firmly resolved must always keep this extracted teaching secret.
uncertainties: kṛta+niścayaḥ may describe the teacher or the recipient; it is taken here as the one who holds the teaching.
plain_english: This extraction must always be kept secret by one who is firmly resolved.
